title: AFMI / Alphamin / Ag Growth / AFOP / Aluflexpack / AFR / AfriSam / Affirm / AmTrust — Structure, Splits, Per-Share Value and Short Timing V9

notes: Raw Short -> actual Long corrections: AFN.UN 2004, AFR 2003 and AFRISJ 2010.
AFRISJ is not an equity idea; it is a Long in AfriSam senior secured floating-rate notes.
AFOP 2010 requires both the August 2010 1-for-5 reverse split and the 2013 2-for-1 stock split before comparing the 2010 entry with Corning's 2016 $18.50/share cash acquisition.
AFOP 2012 requires the 2013 2-for-1 stock split; its 2012 $1.25/share cash distribution is a separate payoff component.
Affinity Media's Hotels at Home merger failed, but the SPAC trust liquidation paid $6.00 cash plus one residual common share per seven cancelled IPO common shares.
Aluflexpack operating results approached the author's 2025 forecast, but the final Constantia takeover at CHF16/share implies a mixed security outcome rather than a pure operating-thesis success.
American Financial Realty Trust's 2007 Gramercy merger consideration was $5.50 cash plus 0.12096 GKK shares and additional dividend-related cash adjustments.
AfriSam restructuring preserved/rolled senior secured claims, but exact holder-level realized IRR is not reconstructed from public data.
Affirm's original $30 short target was exceeded on the downside in 2022, while the business later survived and the stock rebounded.
AmTrust's governance/accounting concerns were partially validated years later, but the stock more than doubled against the short before those catalysts arrived.

batch_lessons: A SPAC common can be attractive even when the proposed merger fails if the trust value is above the purchase price.
Mining reratings require operational recovery and metallurgy/logistics improvement, not merely high ore grade.
Niche industrial cyclicality should be decomposed into replacement demand, market share and maintenance-capex intensity.
Historical AFOP returns are meaningless without both reverse and forward stock-split adjustments.
Operating forecasts can be right while shareholder returns remain weak because valuation multiples and transaction prices are separate variables.
REIT asset growth is not value creation unless AFFO/share and NAV/share improve.
A distressed issuer can contain a good secured-credit security when collateral and restructuring incentives protect the claim.
Short investments require a catalyst and path analysis; eventual thesis validation is insufficient if the stock first doubles against the position.
Target-hit discipline matters on shorts: Affirm later rebounded, but the original $30 target had already been vastly exceeded on the downside.
Corporate-action consideration, cash distributions and split adjustments should take precedence over raw stock charts.
